title: Balancing Weights for Causal Mediation Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2512.09337v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal mediation analysis decomposes the average treatment effect into components that operate through intermediate variables and a component that does not. This paper studies weighting estimation of generalized mediation functionals, whose contrasts include natural direct and indirect effects, for any fixed finite number of causally ordered mediators. Inverse propensity score weights are vulnerable to (a) weight instability, because they are products of estimated probability ratios, and (b) finite-sample covariate and mediator imbalance, which can bias the estimator. We instead propose sequential balancing weights, which address (a) by minimizing weight dispersion and (b) by imposing exact balance. Stage one balances covariates between a treatment group and the full sample. Each later stage adds the next mediator and balances a treatment group against the preceding weighted group. translated_title: 因果中介分析中的平衡权重
translated_abstract: 因果中介分析将平均处理效应分解为通过中间变量起作用的成分和不通过中间变量起作用的成分。本文研究了广义中介泛函的加权估计问题，其对比量包括自然直接效应和自然间接效应，并适用于任意固定有限个具有因果顺序的中介变量。逆倾向得分权重容易受到两个问题的困扰：(a) 权重不稳定，因为它们是估计出的概率比率的乘积；(b) 有限样本下的协变量和中介变量不平衡，这可能使估计量产生偏差。作为替代，我们提出了序贯平衡权重方法，通过最小化权重离散度来解决问题，并通过施加精确平衡来解决问题。第一阶段在处理组与全样本之间平衡协变量；随后每个阶段引入下一个中介变量，并将处理组与前一个加权组进行平衡。本文还给出了增广估计量的有限样本偏差分解……
tldr: 本文提出序贯平衡权重方法，用于估计含任意有限个因果有序中介变量的广义中介泛函（包括自然直接与间接效应），通过最小化权重离散度和施加精确平衡，克服了逆倾向得分权重的不稳定性及有限样本协变量与中介变量不平衡带来的偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sequential balancing weights for estimating generalized mediation functionals with any finite number of causally ordered mediators, addressing the instability and finite-sample covariate/mediator imbalance of inverse propensity score weights by minimizing weight dispersion and enforcing exact balance.
